https://nextool.account.myshopify.com/cu.name: request_return
https://nextool.account.myshopify.com/cu.description:
Allows a customer to request a return for an order.
Either an order_id or an order_number is required.

Use human-readable names for the return reasons (e.g. "size too large" instead of "SIZE_TOO_LARGE")

order_id.description: ID of the order to return, e.g. "gid://Shopify/Order/1234567890"

order_number.description: Buyer-facing number of the order to return (alternative to order_id), e.g. "#MX1001"

line_item_id.description: ID of the line item to return

https://nextool.myshopify.com/api/ucp/mc.name: search_catalog
https://nextool.myshopify.com/api/ucp/mc.description:
Search for products from the online store, hosted on Shopify.

This tool can be used to search for products using natural language queries, specific filter criteria, or both.
At least one of query or filters must be provided.

Results are paginated, with initial results limited to improve experience.
Use the pagination.cursor from the response to fetch additional pages when users request more results.

Response conforms to the UCP catalog search capability (dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.search).

Prices in the response are integers in the currency's ISO 4217 minor units, paired with
a currency code: {"amount": 600, "currency": "USD"} is $6.00 and {"amount": 2500,
"currency": "USD"} is $25.00. Convert to major units before quoting a price to a buyer
(divide by 100 for two-decimal currencies such as USD and EUR; zero-decimal currencies
such as JPY are already whole units).

context.description: Buyer signals for localization and personalization.

address_country.description: Country code in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format.

language.description: Language tag in IETF BCP 47 format.

categories.description: Category filters combined with OR logic.

min.description: Minimum price in minor currency units.

max.description: Maximum price in minor currency units.

available.description: Filter by availability. Default true (only sale-ready items).

https://nextool.myshopify.com/api/ucp/mc.name: lookup_catalog
https://nextool.myshopify.com/api/ucp/mc.description:
Look up multiple products or variants by identifier.
Use this tool to resolve multiple product/variant IDs in a single request.

Supports:
- Product IDs (gid://shopify/Product/...): Returns product with match: "featured"
- Variant IDs (gid://shopify/ProductVariant/...): Returns parent product with the exact variant

Results are grouped by product. Each variant includes an inputs array showing
which request ID resolved to it and whether the match was exact or featured.
In versions that require input correlations, only matched variants are returned.

Prices in the response are integers in the currency's ISO 4217 minor units, paired with
a currency code: {"amount": 600, "currency": "USD"} is $6.00 and {"amount": 2500,
"currency": "USD"} is $25.00. Convert to major units before quoting a price to a buyer
(divide by 100 for two-decimal currencies such as USD and EUR; zero-decimal currencies
such as JPY are already whole units).


Maximum 10 IDs per request.

context.description: Buyer signals for localization and personalization.

address_country.description: Country code in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format.

language.description: Language tag in IETF BCP 47 format.

categories.description: Category filters combined with OR logic.

min.description: Minimum price in minor currency units.

max.description: Maximum price in minor currency units.

available.description: Filter by availability. Default true (only sale-ready items).

https://nextool.myshopify.com/api/mcp.name: search_shop_policies_and_faqs
https://nextool.myshopify.com/api/mcp.description:
Used to get facts about the stores policies, products, or services.
Some examples of questions you can ask are:
  - What is your return policy?
  - What is your shipping policy?
  - What is your phone number?
  - What are your hours of operation?"
Set policy_types to also get the store's written policies (full text and URL).

context.description: Additional information about the request such as user demographics, mood, location, or other relevant details that could help in tailoring the response appropriately.

policy_types.description: Policy kinds to fetch, chosen from the user's question — e.g. ["refund"] for returns/exchanges/damaged items, ["contact"] for phone/hours/address. Include every kind the question touches. Omit it to get only FAQ answers.
